member.name: T:ConDmsLockerCmd.LockerController
member.summary:
Low-level RS-485 locker controller. Protocol: 9600 baud 8N1, BCC = XOR of all payload bytes.
Commands: Unlock single : 8A [board] [lock] 11 [BCC] Check single : 80 [board] [lock] 33 [BCC] Read all : 80 [board] 00 33 [BCC] Unlock multi : 90 [board] [s1] [s2] [s3] [BCC]
